mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cat_product WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM cat_sku WHERE product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY id

SELECT p.* FROM cat_product p JOIN mer_merchant m ON p.merchant_id=m.id WHERE 1=1 AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND ( LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(p.title)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(p.description)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(m.name)) > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(s.id)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(s.spec_key)) > 0)) ) AND p.category_code=#{category}
ORDER BY (SELECT MIN(s.price_cent) FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE') IS NULL, (SELECT MIN(s.price_cent) FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE') ASC,p.id ORDER BY (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(b.on_hand,0)-COALESCE(b.reserved,0),0)),0) FROM cat_sku s LEFT JOIN inv_stock_balance b ON b.store_id=s.store_id AND b.sku_id=s.id WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE') DESC,p.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.* FROM cat_product p JOIN mer_merchant m ON m.id=p.merchant_id WHERE p.id IN #{id} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cat_product p JOIN mer_merchant m ON p.merchant_id=m.id WHERE 1=1 AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND ( LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(p.title)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(p.description)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(m.name)) > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(s.id)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(s.spec_key)) > 0)) ) AND p.category_code=#{category}

SELECT p.* FROM cat_product p WHERE p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND ( LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(p.title)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(p.description)) > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(s.id)) > 0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{query}),LOWER(s.spec_key)) > 0)) ) AND p.category_code=#{category} AND p.status=#{status}
ORDER BY (SELECT MIN(s.price_cent) FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE') IS NULL, (SELECT MIN(s.price_cent) FROM cat_sku s WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE') ASC,p.id ORDER BY (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(b.on_hand,0)-COALESCE(b.reserved,0),0)),0) FROM cat_sku s LEFT JOIN inv_stock_balance b ON b.store_id=s.store_id AND b.sku_id=s.id WHERE s.product_id=p.id AND s.status='ACTIVE') DESC,p.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE cat_product SET title=#{p.title},description=#{p.description},category_code=#{p.categoryCode},image_url=#{p.imageUrl},status=#{p.status},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{p.id} AND version=#{p.version}
UPDATE cat_sku SET price_cent=#{s.priceCent},status=#{s.status},version=#{s.version} WHERE id=#{s.id} AND product_id=#{s.productId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS sku_id,p.id AS product_id,p.merchant_id,p.store_id,p.title,s.spec_key,s.price_cent,p.version,p.status AS product_status,s.status AS sku_status,p.image_url,p.description FROM cat_sku s JOIN cat_product p ON s.product_id=p.id WHERE s.id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM cat_category ORDER BY code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cat_category(code,name,active) VALUES(#{code},#{name},#{active}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name=#{name},active=#{active}
